+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboLab limited-mode policy for placing the raisin box in the grey bin.

+Object and bin centres were estimated from the initial RGB-D observation with

+import pathlib

+    obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True, video="none")
+    directory = RUNS / name
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, image in obs.last.items():
+        from PIL import Image
+        Image.fromarray(image).save(directory / f"{cam}.png")
+    with open(directory / "state.json", "w") as f:
+        json.dump({"meta": obs.meta, "proprio": obs.meta["proprio"]}, f, indent=2)
+    return obs
+
+
+def show_state(label, obs):
+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)

+        "tcp_pose": p[8:15].tolist(),
+        "gripper_cmd": float(p[15]),
+        "opening_m": float(p[24]),
+        "effort_nm": p[25:32].tolist(),
+        "done": obs.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": obs.meta.get("reason"),
+        "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+    }))
+
+
+def move(robot, label, target):
+    res = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float32)[None, :],
+                       video="mp4", video_fps=3, note=label)
+    directory = RUNS / label
+    res.save(str(directory))
+    print(label, json.dumps({
+        "done": res.meta.get("done"),
+        "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+        "plan": res.meta.get("plan"),

+        "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s"),

+    # Approach above the box, lower the fingertips to the object's lower half,
+    # close, then lift high enough to clear the bin rim.
+    if move(robot, "pick_approach", pose(*RAISIN_XY, 0.145, 0.0)):
+        return True
+    if move(robot, "pick_lower", pose(*RAISIN_XY, 0.018, 0.0)):
+        return True
+    now = np.asarray(robot.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    arm = now[:7]

+    actions = np.tile(np.r_[arm, 1.0], (6, 1)).astype(np.float32)
